text:
Maya (PM): quick standup thread for GA acceptance criteria. Need to finalize gating checklist by EOD Fri: SLA language, support scope, monitoring signal list, public docs + quickstart, and a conservative pricing floor. who can take each item?
Sam - Eng: I can take SLA targets + fallback policy. Suggest we frame SLA as availability + latency windows. Maybe keep latency as a labelled guide ("expected p95") not a hard SLA except for Premium.
Sam - Eng: rough SLA idea (draft):
```
Availability SLA: 99.5% monthly (Standard), 99.9% monthly (Premium)
Latency guidance: Expected p95 (Standard) <= 150ms, (Premium) <= 80ms
Credits: outage credit schedule + partial credit for sustained p95 breaches
```
Jo (Docs): I'll draft both the public-facing short blurb and the internal ops runbook. Need the exact credit math and what constitutes "outage" from legal. Can we get a template?
Priya - Support: Support scope: propose P0 (customer-impacting GA failures) -> 24/7 page; P1 -> business hours page + next-available oncall; P2 -> async ticket. Also require an AE-facing one-liner for customers.
Liam (Sales): pricing needs a firm floor today. Sales recommends a base commitment tied to the Standard SLO: suggest starting commit = 1,000 rps sustained for pricing baseline; also propose an "accelerated support" add-on for GA with 2-week ramp.
Eli - SRE: monitoring/signals list (recommendation):
- availability (5xx / 4xx patterns)
- p50/p95/p99 latency per model-class
- backend GPU OOM / host CPU saturation
- cache hit ratio drop > 10%
- request queue depth rising > threshold
We'll need runbook mapping for each signal.
Maya (PM): good. let's capture acceptance criteria as checkboxes:
1) SLA doc (owner + public wording)
2) Runbook with triage + rollback steps
3) L1 training session + cheat-sheet
4) Alert definitions + PD mappings
5) Public quickstart + FAQ
6) Pricing floor + any beta surcharge language
All must be signed off by product, eng, support, legal, and finance.
Sam - Eng: on fallbacks: propose automatic route to a lower-fidelity quantized model when latency SLO is breached for >30s for a particular shard. Must be explicit in runbook (and opt-out-able by customer).
Jo (Docs): question: do we show fallback to customers in the API response (via header/field) so they can detect degraded quality? That's helpful for customers to alter UX.
Priya - Support: yes please surface a header like x-rw-fallback: quantized-v1. Support will need that in the triage script.
Liam (Sales): if we expose fallback header, legal wants it in the SLA and the marketing blurb needs to be careful. Sales ok with opt-out for enterprise.
Eli - SRE: alert thresholds proposal for GA smoke:
- p95 > guidance + 20% for 5m -> Sev2
- p95 > guidance + 50% for 3m -> Sev1
- errors > 1% for 5m -> Sev1
Also a rolling-cost alert if burn exceeds forecast by 30% in 1h.
Sam - Eng: I'll add a short cost model per 10k tokens and per 1000 requests so Sales/Finance can sanity check.
Jo (Docs): doc timeline: public quickstart draft in 48h, internal runbook v0 in 5d. I'll include the header examples, FAQ, and the AE one-liner.
Priya - Support: training: recommend a 90-minute walkthrough + 30-min dry-run with oncall for the first week. I'll create incident templates and the escalation matrix and share here.
Maya (PM): approvals: legal signoff needed for credits table + fallback wording. Finance signoff needed on pricing floor and any surcharge templates. Product to collate signoffs.
Liam (Sales): sales asks: can we offer a limited "GA: priority support" addon at 20% surcharge and an "enterprise beta SLA" for customers willing to pay for custom SLOs?
Eli - SRE: note: the dedicated pool route for Premium requires capacity reservation. We should prevent overcommit at GA. Recommend capacity buffer of 30% reserved for Premium.
Sam - Eng: agree. we should include an explicit capacity gating criterion before enabling Premium in a region.
Jo (Docs): content question: do we publish full SLO numbers or a simplified statement + link to detailed docs? Prefer simplified public blurb + detailed linked doc for transparency.
Maya (PM): simplified blurb public, detailed SLO in docs with legal-approved credit math.
Priya - Support: blockers: need access to the runbook draft repo and a meeting time for training. Also need the fallback header spec.
Sam - Eng: will upload fallback spec & credit calc by EOD tomorrow.
Liam (Sales): blocker: finance needs the per-10k-token cost estimate to finalize floor pricing. Sam and Eli, can you give a joint estimate?
Eli - SRE: I can draft infra cost assumptions (GPU hr, avg token/s, avg batch) and share a model. Sam will map to per-request.
release-bot: release-bot: canary v2.4 deployed to staging (sha: d4f5g6). smoke tests passed. :tada:
Maya (PM): next steps owners recap:
- SLA + fallback + cost mapping -> Sam + Eli (draft by tomorrow EOD)
- Runbook + public quickstart -> Jo (quickstart 48h, runbook v0 in 5d)
- Support templates + training -> Priya (training draft 2d)
- Pricing floor + beta add-ons -> Liam + Finance (Liam to coordinate)
- Legal review -> Maya to ping legal once Sam uploads wording
Please reply if dates won't work. We'll lock the launch checklist after signoffs. :white_check_mark:
Maya (PM): tagging @legal @finance for visibility.
Sam - Eng: one more note: include a conservative "kill switch" in the runbook (global disable + region drain) and ensure customers are notified via status page.
Jo (Docs): adding kill-switch steps to runbook outline.
Priya - Support: added: customer notification template for status page + AE script.
Liam (Sales): will draft GA pricing pitch + AE script and post here.
Eli - SRE: scheduling a 30-min run-through of alerts + dashboard tomorrow 10:30am. invite incoming.
Maya (PM): thanks team. If no further issues I'll convert this thread into the formal checklist and attach sign-off columns. :rocket:
